source_checks.quote: Goldberg et al. (2007) showed that initially providing skewed input facilitated rapid construction generalization. The present study investigates this effect for the position of verbs with relative high token frequency. Relative here denotes that the high token frequency of verbs is adjusted for the experimental groups (four times for +the skewed group or twice for the −skewed group). We expect significant positive effects for the forward order of frequent verbs and positive main effects for order of frequent verbs.
